package.name: phm_recovery
package.description: PHM recovery node: subscribes to /phm/health (PolicyHealthStatus) and, only when recovery.enabled is true, publishes zero-velocity Twist on /phm/cmd_vel while HOLD or STOP_AND_HOLD is actuating. SafetyEnvelope ported from HELIX (per-action cooldown, RESUME exempt from cooldown, action allowlist); pluggable rewind hook (default: log and hold). Logic in phm_core.
